name: Illaoi
notes: Opens with Leap of Faith (R) at t=0 for its own damage, to spawn one extra Tentacle (only the dummy is present to be hit) and halve Harsh Lesson's cooldown for its 8 s window; R is recast on cooldown afterward, though at typical haste it rarely comes off cooldown again inside a short fight.

Tentacle Smash (Q) is cast on cooldown; Harsh Lesson (W) is armed right after a landing attack (an attack reset) and its cooldown starts when that empowered attack lands, matching its post-effect cooldown start, then rearmed as soon as it is next ready.

Every tentacle slam (Q's own slam, and the slam(s) Harsh Lesson commands) uses the passive's shared slam formula, amplified by Tentacle Smash's rank bonus, and shares one 0.66 s stacking damage-reduction window against the dummy (50% less per recent slam, capped at 75% less), tracked across all of Illaoi's slams.

One Tentacle is assumed already up near terrain at t=0 so Q/W can command it immediately (see assumed); Leap of Faith adds a second Tentacle for its 8 s duration, so Harsh Lesson commands two simultaneous slams while it is active.

Test of Spirit's echo needs a second health pool (the Spirit) that this engine cannot represent, since it never exposes the target's armor/MR to the driver. We assume Illaoi's own first tentacle-equivalent hit kills the Spirit almost immediately, so Test of Spirit is modeled as: on cast, one echo hit equal to its rank's damage-transfer percent of a representative tentacle slam, followed by one autonomous Vessel-phase tentacle slam at the level-based interval, then recast on cooldown. This is a simplification of a mechanic the dossier itself flags as needing bespoke, currently-unresolved simulation (see the dossier's 'needsBespoke' and first 'unsettled' entry).

Tentacle Smash's and Test of Spirit's real cast times (0.75 s / 0.25 s) are not modeled as separate damage delays: like Jax's Leap Strike, their damage is treated as landing on cast, gated only by the usual 0.25 s attack lockout. Leap of Faith's 0.5 s cast time is modeled as a real delay since its damage explicitly lands after the leap completes.

Harsh Lesson's bonus damage is the higher of its %max-health scaling and its flat minimum, the common reading of 'additional damage, with a minimum threshold'; its 300 damage cap against non-champions is ignored since the fight's dummy counts as a champion.
Mana is not modeled: Illaoi's costs are modest relative to a level-16 mana pool and are unlikely to bind inside a short fight.
The passive's missing-health heal and all non-damage Vessel/Spirit mechanics (slow, sight, gold, tether visuals) are ignored since they do not change damage dealt.

assumed.why: the passive Tentacle spawns on a level-based timer near any terrain; assume one is already up at the start of the fight so Q/W can command it immediately, as is typical near any lane terrain

the engine cannot simulate the Spirit's own health/armor/MR pool, so we assume Illaoi's own first hit kills it almost instantly, letting Test of Spirit resolve as a single echo instance on cast rather than a multi-hit burst-down sequence
